This is the classic **"bacterial streaming" diagnostic test**, used specifically to identify *Ralstonia solanacearum* infection. When a cut stem from an infected plant is placed in water, bacterial exudate (ooze) streams out of the vascular tissue, creating white/milky threads — a hallmark diagnostic confirmation of bacterial wilt.

**Class narrowing:**
- The streaming test is the definitive diagnostic for *Ralstonia solanacearum*, which causes **Southern Bacterial Wilt** (also sometimes called Bacterial Wilt)
- Brown vascular discoloration confirms systemic vascular infection
- The clear water turns cloudy from bacterial exudate streaming — classic for Ralstonia
